name: aws
description: Expert guide for the AWS CLI v2 — install/update and version pinning, authentication (IAM Identity Center SSO, short-term credentials, assume-role, credential precedence), profiles and config/credentials files, scripting with --query JMESPath and --output, pagination, return codes, s3 vs s3api, and v1-to-v2 migration.

interface.shortDescription: AWS CLI guidance: auth, profiles, scripting
interface.longDescription: Use AWS CLI to install and pin the AWS CLI v2, untangle authentication (IAM Identity Center SSO, short-term credentials, assume-role, the credential provider chain), manage profiles and config files, and write reliable scripts with --query JMESPath filtering, machine-readable output, pagination controls, and proper exit-code handling.
defaultPrompt: Use AWS CLI to fix my expired SSO session error.
Use AWS CLI to set up profiles for my two AWS accounts.
Use AWS CLI to write a script that lists untagged EC2 instances.
